notes.title: New Playrooms Experience!
notes.content:
📢 Update: New Playrooms Experience!
Hello everyone,
With this update, you can now experience the brand-new Playrooms!

Here’s what’s new:

General performance and stability improvements

The Pinkrooms puzzle has been replaced with a more atmosphere-fitting puzzle

A new obstacle has been added in Playrooms that you’ll need to overcome to progress

Fixed issues where the VHS setting could bug out in certain situations

We’re incredibly grateful for all the support you’ve given us from the very beginning. Without you, we wouldn’t have made it this far. If you encounter any issues, please let us know through comments, discussions, or our Discord—we’ll be happy to listen and work quickly to resolve them.

From now on, NextPhase will be focusing on our new fast-paced, terrifying true FPS project:
🎮 Backrooms: Rogue 0 – where you’ll have to escape from entities.

👉 Stay up to date on Rogue 0 by joining the dedicated Discord server!

Thank you for everything—it’s been an amazing journey!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/2906334d2359f02e8e43cc5f1a01751f7dda034c.gif"]

notes.title: Playrooms Reimagined + Pinkrooms Puzzle Overhaul
notes.content:
✨ Surprise Update Announcement!
Hello everyone,

We’re thrilled to share some exciting news with you — a surprise update is just around the corner, and here’s what you can expect:
🌀 Playrooms Chapter — Completely Remade
Based on community feedback that the Playrooms chapter felt more like a maze than a true liminal space, we’ve rebuilt it from the ground up. The brand-new version will be available in just a few days!

It will fully replace the old chapter. Players who have already progressed can simply select Chapter 4 and continue from there.

Staying true to our vision, interaction remains a key part of Liminal Shift. In the new Playrooms, you’ll need to open a gate. Don’t worry — it’s not even a puzzle. Just explore, interact with a couple of objects, and the path forward will reveal itself.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/171ce6147639c41fa5e58f5186c820cdc673f405.png"]
🌸 Pinkrooms Puzzle — Redesigned
We’ve heard your feedback! Around half of the players found the puzzle in Pinkrooms frustrating or out of place. To improve the experience:

The puzzle has been replaced with one that better matches the atmosphere.

Interactions that could cause bugs or softlocks have been fixed.
⚙️ General Improvements
Significant optimization upgrades have been made across the game.

The VHS setting bug in the options menu, reported by some players, has now been resolved.
👀 Bonus News
NextPhase is also working on a brand-new backrooms game — this time fast-paced, featuring entities, chase sequences, and full voice acting. Stay tuned!

notes.title: HOTFIX V1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

-This hotfix fully resolves a long-standing issue where previously unlocked chapters would become locked again when returning to explore an earlier chapter.

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I want to apologize for the delay. A lot has happened, and those who joined our Discord server (currently around 100 members) are already aware of most of the news. If you'd like to support the development, share your ideas, or just stay in the loop, feel free to join us too. So, I’ll keep this announcement brief and to the point.

Unfortunately, there is no longer a team behind the project. As many of you know, NextPhase was a small group of developers. However, due to financial constraints and life circumstances, NextPhase is now a solo-dev operation. There's no need to worry—everything is still on track. The entire concept of Liminal Shift, its artistic direction, and design have always been mine as the creator and lead developer. These changes won’t affect the quality of the game, but the roadmap has shifted and, unfortunately, development will take a bit longer. Now, let’s get into the exciting updates and what’s changing!

Chapter 2 is now titled the Bonus Chapter.

This chapter will be significantly different from the first episode. It won’t be just a walking simulator—expect more horror, interactivity, and puzzles that will require you to think in order to progress. Because of these differences, it will come with a content disclaimer and be labeled as a "Bonus Chapter." Development has already begun, and a large part of its design is already completed. Here are some details about it:

PINKROOMS

In this bonus chapter, you’ll find yourself in Level 947—a seemingly peaceful backrooms level. At first glance, it appears cute and calm, but beneath the surface lies something deeply unsettling. You may encounter an [strike]entity[/strike], and you'll need to take certain actions to move forward through this surreal home. Your goal is to find a way out. Remember: while Level 947 might be considered safe, you [strike]should NOT[/strike] stay there for too long.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/851c9225144c75237408ec45eb28b9e59b0ef981.png
YouTube, Devlogs

I’m also excited to share another piece of news: I’ll be starting devlogs on YouTube very soon!
Through short and fun videos, I’ll be sharing everything from what the game has gone through to how Liminal Shift is being developed and what’s coming in the future. This is a great step forward for NextPhase, so subscribing to the YouTube channel would be an AMAZING way to support the project!

YouTube Link: https://www.youtube.com/@NextPhaseStudios

Now, let’s talk about some upcoming changes to the current build of the game:

-There are certain moments in Liminal Shift where the silence is both peaceful and terrifying, it makes you hesitate before taking your next step. To heighten these feelings and enhance the sense of progress, the free save system will be replaced by a checkpoint-based system in the next menu update.

-I’m aware of the bug that causes you to fall out of the world in the office corridor, and this will be fixed with the upcoming menu update.

-If you encounter any more bugs before the full release, feel free to report them via Discord. I’ll personally take care of them (after all, there’s no one else left, funny but true).

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/zrNJBmhxSu

Liminal Shift will officially release with the Pinkrooms chapter. However, the number of bonus chapters may increase in the future, and existing chapters may be improved or expanded. That entirely depends on you and your feedback.

With Pinkrooms, we’re taking a major step toward making Liminal Shift stand out from other liminal space games, just as we always intended.

Thank you so much for reading.
Your support through Discord, YouTube subscriptions, and simply liking this announcement means the world to me.

With respect,
See you soon!

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we apologize for the slight delay. We have some survey results, good news, and bad news to share. Let’s start with the results.


 75% of players agreed that walking and running speeds should be increased. As a result, the character’s movement speed will be reviewed again.
 82% of players voted for changes to the menu and progression system. In response, the entire menu has been redesigned, and a progression system has been integrated into the game.
 68% of players wanted small puzzles and actions required to progress. Based on this, Episode 2 will be much more interactive, featuring objects to find and use. Additionally, we have carefully read all the suggestions left in the final text box. Your ideas will play a significant role in Episode 2.

Now for the bad news: Due to the small size of our team and financial challenges, we unfortunately have to indefinitely postpone Episode 2 for now. However, this indefinite delay won’t last too long. We don’t want to keep you waiting too much, but we ask for your understanding.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/6210fa872e7a5a3a8eb9b666f45740b55d72add3.png
We’ve taken note of your ideas and expectations for Episode 2 and a unique liminal experience—a semi-open world filled with abandoned, desolate neighborhoods and streets, with a deeply eerie atmosphere. This aligns perfectly with our vision. We want to create a semi-open world where every player can wander and relax, sometimes feeling uneasy, with each area being distinct and unique. More interactions, required materials for progression, and much more are part of our plans.

We will be sharing more information and videos about Episode 2 soon. However, for now, we must fully postpone the roadmap. We’ll try to release an announcement with exact dates as soon as possible. Please remember that NextPhase is still a small studio in terms of both manpower and finances. We are doing our absolute best to make sure the wait is worth it.

Thank you once again for your understanding and support! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us in the comments and discussions—we read and carefully consider every message.

See you at next updates!

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

With this hotfix, we are addressing the save issue that affected some players and making changes to how the New Game function works.

The New Game button will now completely reset all your progress and settings, giving you a fully clean start.

Due to changes in the game's progression system, you will need to start over. However, if you absolutely do not want to restart, feel free to reach out to us on Discord, and we’ll do our best to assist you.

Once again, thank you! If you encounter any issues, please let us know in the comments or discussions. Also, please remember that Liminal Shift is still in Early Access and actively in development—we continue to improve thanks to your feedback and reports.

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT EARLY ACCESS V1.1
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

The long-awaited date has arrived! We apologize for the slight delay—it took us some time to resolve a few issues. But now, we have some huge news for you! Let’s dive right in!

You spoke, we listened! One of the biggest problems and complaints during the early access phase is now completely resolved with this update! Introducing a fully dynamic free save and checkpoint system! Yes, from now on, every time you return to the main menu, you can simply press the Continue button and pick up right where you left off.

Additionally, since Episode 1 is now complete, we have locked all chapters and implemented a progression system based on your requests. Now, in order to unlock new chapters, you’ll need to play through and complete the previous ones!

Now for the real big news!

The main menu design and functionality have been completely overhauled! Settings now work flawlessly, and all your customizations are saved instantly, ensuring a smoother and more seamless experience.

When you enter the main menu, you’ll notice a surprise! The environment you see belongs to Liminal Shift: Episode 2! Our team has started experimenting with visual effects and design prototypes for Episode 2, and the background of the main menu is taken directly from an area in the upcoming episode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/c75b549a29de90d0087bf55adba1e824e2a1c001.png
Episode 2 – A Unique Vision

We have some unprecedented ideas for Episode 2. We are considering making it a semi-open world, delivering a truly one-of-a-kind liminal experience like never before. However, nothing is set in stone yet, and we are still in the experimental stages.

Soon, we will release a poll to gather your feedback and adjust our direction accordingly. But one thing is certain: what you will experience will be unlike anything you've seen before. That being said, such big ideas may likely result in a delay for the full release of the game.

Episode 2 will be completely free for everyone who owns the game! It will offer a completely different experience from Episode 1, with more horror elements—you may even encounter strangers.

Thank You for Your Support!

Thank you for being with us from the beginning! Your ideas matter to us, and we will be collecting more of your thoughts soon. Remember, this is just the beginning! We’ll see you again soon—drop your comments below, and we wish you an unforgettable experience!

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT EARLY ACCESS V1.0
notes.content:
Liminal Shift Early Access v1.0 is Here!

Hello everyone!  

We apologize for the small delay, but the time has finally come for Liminal Shift Early Access v1.0!
With this update, we’re bringing the game even closer to the best version we envisioned. Here are the update details:  

- New Chapter
A new chapter (Sewers) has been added! This chapter is connected to Chapter 5 (Bathrooms). Players who want to jump straight into the new content can start from Chapter 5. This has always been our plan for Chapter 5. The Sewers chapter takes approximately 20 to 45 minutes to complete, depending on the player's playstyle.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/8da0f78d16982be36b06beba1f8b80d9dfd89b2d.png

- Fisheye Disable Option  
The fisheye effect can now be fully disabled from the settings.  

- Known Issues
- For some players, settings adjusted in the menu may not apply in-game. Please check your settings in-game if you encounter this issue. We are actively working on a fix.  

Thank you for your support from the very beginning! See you in future updates and next steps!

notes.title: LIMINAL SHIFT ROADMAP
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

First of all, we would like to thank each and every one of you for your interest in and support for Liminal Shift! As we’ve always said, we have many plans for Liminal Shift and are absolutely committed to continuing its development. This announcement will fully inform you about the future of Liminal Shift, so we kindly ask you to read it.

First, we apologize once again for any delays or potential delays. Please remember that NextPhase is still a small game studio, and any developer falling ill can disrupt the entire development process. Thank you once again for your patience and support.

We’ve prepared a roadmap for you, which you can see below. Let’s dive into the detailed explanation of this roadmap:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/0fa2634a7b8b7b39f43a73ef4a4e172f3a29cd8c.png

New Chapter / Fisheye Effect Disable Option

As we mentioned before, when Liminal Shift was released in early access, our ideas were not yet finalized. We don’t want to finish Liminal Shift until it fully aligns with our vision. That’s why, on February 10th, we’re adding a new chapter between Chapter 5 and Chapter 6. This chapter will be connected to Chapter 5 and will offer approximately 30 minutes of gameplay. It will feature a darker and more chaotic concept! Additionally, on February 10th, we’re introducing a Fisheye Effect Disable Option to ensure that everyone can experience Liminal Shift in the most enjoyable way possible.

Your Opinion

On February 12th, we’re introducing something completely new! We’ll launch a survey and a form to gather your feedback about the game. Through this survey, you’ll be able to share the features and content you’d like to see in the game. However, there will be some conditions: your suggestions must not compromise the essence of the game. Liminal Shift is an atmospheric thriller that does not include monsters, chases, or jump scares. You’ll be able to share your ideas while staying true to the game’s core identity. We want Liminal Shift to stand out and diversify with your input!

Implementing Your Opinion

On February 25th, we’ll review all the surveys and forms, and begin turning your ideas into reality!

New Chapter / Ultimate VHS Experience

On March 10th, a completely new chapter is coming! You can think of this as Episode 2—a brand-new experience that will differ from the first story and setting. Additionally, on March 10th, we’re introducing a brand-new VHS Experience, where everything will feel almost entirely real! You’ll feel the full effect and tension of a VHS tape like never before.

Full Release / New Chapter

On April 15th, we’re bringing another completely new chapter! This chapter will be connected to Episode 2 and serve as its continuation. With this new chapter and Episode 2, Liminal Shift will officially transition to its full release!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274217/a7c99964fb42b95d8b264279fabd4e9b59780912.png

Thank you for being with us on this journey from the very beginning. As we promised on day one, we strive to engage with all discussions and listen to everyone’s opinions. Thank you again for everything, and we’ll keep you updated if there are any changes. See you on February 10th!

notes.title: Early Access v0.1 Hotfix
notes.content: The issue of no water sound coming from a corridor has been resolved.

notes.title: HOTFIX V0.2
notes.content:
Hello!  
First of all, we would like to thank you for your interest in the demo of *Liminal Shift* over the past five days.  
We’ve been carefully listening to all your feedback and have been updating the game accordingly. Here are some of the improvements:  

Fixes:  

 An issue where water appeared floating incorrectly for some players has been resolved.  
 Missing sounds have been restored, and overall sound accuracy has been improved.  
 Lighting and reflection issues encountered by some players have been fixed.  


New Features:  

 A new option to adjust head-bobbing intensity has been added to the settings menu!
 Controller support added!   
 Floating companions have been added to the Poolrooms chapter to keep you company!  
 Updates introduced in Chapter 2's full version are now available in the demo!  
 A bug causing the same sound to play repeatedly when answering ringing phones has been fixed!  
 Lighting and reflection consistency has been enhanced!  
 Atmospheric sounds added in the full version are now part of the demo!  
 Various design improvements have been implemented!  


Thank you to everyone who has supported us from the beginning. We’ve heard you and will continue to listen.  

Liminal Shift is set to release in its full version on December 25th, with no changes to the release date for now.  
See you on December 25th, We'll explore the unknown together!

notes.title: DEMO HOTFIX V0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, we want to thank each and every one of you who tried the demo version of Liminal Shift in this early stage!

We’ve been listening to your feedback, fixing bugs, and introducing new features. Here are some highlights:

Hotfix v0.1

 Soft lock bug fixed: Resolved an issue in the Poolrooms area where players could jump down and become stuck without a way back up.
 Missing sounds fixed: Improved missing sounds, as well as enhanced sound effects and echoes.
 Object collision fixed: Adjusted objects that caused unintended camera movements when approached.
 Lighting improvements: Enhanced lighting adjustments to improve quality in certain areas.
 Localization fixes: Addressed language-specific errors in localization.
 Major issue fixed: Resolved a widespread issue where glowing lights and materials would not render or function correctly for all players.

New Features

 Footstep volume control: A new sound level adjustment feature has been added to the menu for footsteps.
 Updated rooms: New rooms from the full version's ongoing development have been integrated and updated in the demo.
 Design improvements: Corridors and rooms in Chapter 2 have received design updates in the demo.

Once again, a huge thank you to the hundreds of players who tried the demo! We’re eager to hear your feedback. See you where emotions collide!
